sections.heading: 1. Charging by Rubbing (Static Electricity)
points: When two objects are **rubbed**, they get **charged** (acquire static electric charge) by transfer of charge.
There are **two kinds of charge: positive (+) and negative (−)**.
**Like charges repel; unlike charges attract** (e.g. a charged balloon attracts paper bits).
A charged body can be discharged; **an electroscope** detects whether an object is charged.

sections.heading: 2. Lightning
points: **Lightning** = a huge electric **discharge** between clouds, or between a cloud and the ground.
Charges accumulate in clouds; when they become large enough, they jump across as a **giant spark** (with **thunder**).
The **transfer of charge between clouds and Earth** produces lightning; it can be **deadly**.

sections.heading: 3. Lightning Safety and the Conductor
points: During lightning: **stay indoors**; avoid open fields, tall trees, poles, metal objects, water bodies.
A **lightning conductor** = a metal rod fixed on tall buildings, connected to the ground, that **safely carries the lightning charge to the earth**, protecting the building.
**Earthing** provides a safe path for charge.

sections.heading: 4. Earthquakes
points: An **earthquake** = sudden shaking of the Earth's crust due to movement of **lithospheric (tectonic) plates** along **faults**.
The energy travels as **seismic waves**; the point of origin (inside) = **focus**, the point above on the surface = **epicentre**.
Measured by a **seismograph**; strength on the **Richter scale** (a reading above ~7 is very destructive).
Safety: earthquake-resistant buildings; take cover under a table, stay away from tall objects.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Rubbing charges objects; two charges (+/−); like repel, unlike attract; detected by an electroscope.
Lightning = electric discharge between clouds/ground; produces thunder.
Lightning conductor = metal rod carrying charge safely to earth.
Earthquake = crust shaking due to plate movement along faults; energy = seismic waves.
Focus (inside) vs epicentre (surface above); measured by seismograph on the Richter scale.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Like charges repel; unlike charges attract.**
A **lightning conductor** carries charge **safely to the ground** — it does not attract lightning to harm.
**Focus** = origin **inside** the Earth; **epicentre** = point on the **surface** above it.
During lightning, **stay away from tall trees, poles and open fields** — go indoors.
